assessment.governing_intent: Produce a live-profile liveness receipt bundle for SF-REQ-056-AC-08, capability live_liveness_receipts. On an independently authorized live workload, the bundle must show that a dropped trigger is recovered within G+I, gated on healthy independent scans and available evidence. It must also show provider/judgment block suppression, attributed resolution, and delayed-delivery and restart duplicate safety. It must include exact real outcome readback, one-writer confirmation and retained attention linkage. Offline or sandbox success alone is explicitly insufficient and cannot retire the bootstrap (SWF-29).
implementation_unknowns: Exact definitions and numeric values of the G and I bounds in the recovery window, expected to come from the pinned Phase 9 shared contracts.
Concrete FX-B2 fixture commands, inputs, expected outcomes and evidence schema. These are to be pinned before implementation per the proof order, but depend on the bound live target.
How to induce a dropped trigger, a provider/judgment block, delayed delivery and a restart on the live workload in a controlled, authorized, non-destructive way.
How to demonstrate intact/fault/restored discrimination for the mechanical controls, including negative-control application counts.
Mechanism for confirming one-writer ownership and retained attention linkage from live observations rather than inference.
Location and shape of the existing shared harness (S0) and the predecessor proof artifacts to reuse.
material_risks: Operating against a live workload risks side effects, such as duplicate outcomes or induced faults leaking into real processing, if the fault injection and restart exercise is not tightly bounded.
Local or sandbox results could be mislabelled or treated as operational proof, which is contrary to the explicit rule that offline success alone fails.
The reported authority disposition and predecessor DONE status are relayed through an observing session and have not been independently verified by this gate. A mismatch would also block execution.
Budget may be misread as zero or the task could proceed without an allocation, contrary to the rule that missing measurements are holds, never zero.
Undefined G+I bounds or evidence-schema drift could make the verdict non-discriminating if not pinned before implementation.
Concurrent live writers or shared-file edits could violate the one-writer constraint if parallelism is not enforced.
assessment.next_action: Route to the authorized allocator and the Program Director to (1) bind a specific authorized live workload/target for this liveness exercise within the scope of the 2026-09-26 grant, (2) establish readback access to that target, and (3) allocate budget and custody for the live exercise. Once these are bound, pin the FX-B2 fixture commands, expected outcomes and evidence schema against the target, then re-run Agent Ready on that revision. Meanwhile, labelled local L1 proof may proceed, without any claim toward SWF-29 retirement.
assessment.rationale: HOLD controls because the completion predicate (SF-REQ-056-AC-08) can only be satisfied by an actual exercise on an authorized live workload with real readback. The task text itself reports that this target, its readback access and the budget/custody for the exercise are not yet bound or allocated, and that the Founder grant explicitly does not bind them or authorize new spend. These are missing external prerequisites and allocations, not unresolved owner intent: the desired behavior, the authority boundaries and the prohibition on offline substitution are all stated clearly. CLARIFY is therefore not warranted. The work is one cohesive liveness property with a single meaningful independent verdict, so SPLIT is not warranted. The remaining engineering unknowns (G+I values, fixture pinning, fault injection mechanics) would not by themselves block handoff. READY is precluded because the prerequisites for execution and verification are unavailable.
assessment.summary: Intent and acceptance are coherent and owner-level decisions appear settled. The text reports that the Founder disposed POSTW1-DECIDE-006A and EXPLICIT_LIVE_TRANSPORT_PROOF_AUTHORITY on 2026-09-26 and that all five predecessors are DONE. These are reported facts, not independently verified here. The task text itself says several necessary external prerequisites remain unbound: (1) an authorized live workload/target for this liveness exercise, (2) readback access to that target, and (3) budget and custody allocation for the live exercise. The authority grant explicitly does not identify or bind a live target and does not authorize new external spend. The acceptance criterion requires a real live exercise with actual readback, and local substitutes cannot satisfy it. The work therefore cannot reach its completion predicate until these become available. This is an availability and allocation gap, not unresolved product intent.
assessment.verification_assessment: Acceptance is observable in principle. A live-profile receipt bundle can be inspected: lost-trigger recovery within G+I, suppression under provider/judgment block, attributed resolution, duplicate safety across delayed delivery and restart, exact outcome readback, a single writer and retained attention linkage. The evidence contract also specifies what to retain: revisions, commands, exit status, immutable observation refs and a separate independent verdict. A single independent verdict by a fresh verifier on the exact candidate SHA plus the live receipts is meaningful, because the criteria form one cohesive liveness property on one workload. That verdict is only reachable once a live target with readback exists. Local L1 proof may proceed but must be labelled as such and cannot satisfy AC-08.
